**Direct Channel ADR at Miami Beach Resort Q3 2025**

• The Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the Direct channel at Miami Beach Resort in Q3 2025 was $182 [case_study_miami_beach_resort.md | 1 | Q3 2025].
• This represented the highest ADR among all channels evaluated during the quarter [case_study_miami_beach_resort.md | 1 | Q3 2025].
• Direct bookings generated $182 ADR compared to $167 for both Booking.com and Expedia OTA channels [kpi_miami_beach_resort.csv | 1 | Q3 2025].
• The direct channel also achieved the highest RevPAR of $134.68 in Q3 2025 [case_study_miami_beach_resort.md | 1 | Q3 2025].
